Novelty is moderate. The method combines known soft latent reasoning, entropy-based confidence heuristics, and answer-forcing control tokens; positioning against closely related hybrid, shortcut, SoftCoT/SoftCoT++, and early-exit/budgeted reasoning methods is incomplete.

Hyperparameters are tuned per dataset and model, including alpha values, with no held-out validation split or tuning-cost accounting. This raises test-set overfitting concerns and weakens the claim of a robust plug-and-play method.

Key ablations are missing: entropy-driven switching versus fixed/random switching, switch-count control versus simple forced final-answer prompting, dynamic switching without thinking-token mixing, and comparisons to concise/budget-aware CoT baselines.
